items: 【Adjustable Height】12.2in(L) x 12.2in(W) x 70.87in(H), The 4-tier garden trellis offers ample space for growth. You can freely adjust the height from 35 to 71 inches according to plant growth needs.

【Rustproof & Heavy-Duty Steel Poles】The metal obelisk trellis is made of PVC-coated iron, thickened 0.43-inch diameter pipe provides strong support for climbing plants. It can also withstand various outdoor elements, such as sunlight, rain, and wind. It is an ideal choice for year-round gardening.

【Enhanced Stability】Compared to other plant support trellis, which can easily tip over and fracture, our vertical tower tomato trellis provide greater stability. The tower-style design can provide stable support for vines, roses, and vegetables.

【Easy to Assemble】No tools required; the climbing plant trellis can be easily installed within 10 minutes. The detachable tower garden trellis is easy to store and saves space. Note: To ensure that the soil insertion depth reaches the maximum value, please install the 4pcs longest pipes at the bottom in place..

【Decorative＆Widely Application】The garden trellis provides strong support for climbing plants such as roses, vines, tomatoes, cucumbers, clematis, morning glories, peas, beans, and other flowering vines. It is ideal for patio, lawn, outdoor garden, yard, terrace, or indoor living room. Tips: this Obelisk Trellis is suitable for pots with a diameter greater than 17 inches.
